question:
The following graph shows the production of cotton cloth (in lakh metres) by three companies A, B and C over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96fe7ff19a8269cfd70d2572920d80f8450c9ce6bfcc4bfd0c0f1c45ff3df539.png] 

What is the ratio of the production of Company C in the years 1996 and 1997 to the production of Company B in the years 1999 and 2000?
solution:
Production of company C in the years 1996 and 1997 = 40 + 62

⇒ 102

Production of company B in the years 1999 and 2000 = 49 + 55

⇒ 104

Required ratio = 102 ∶ 104

51 ∶ 52

**∴ The ratio of the production of Company C in the years 1996 and 1997 to the production of Company B in the years 1999 and 2000 IS 51 ∶ 52**
